correctness.rationale: Conjugate the positive diagonal deck shift T(a)=a+q1 in the published integer lift by target affine sign δ and coordinate permutation: F∘T=T^δ∘F; source maps and rotations give + while reflections give -. Nonextremal winding classes of cycle-to-cycle Hom produce circles, extremal classes isolated points. Color rotations merge gcd(2,k) phase components for each winding; reflection pairs ±w and reverses zero-winding classes, so rational transfer gives the stated Betti counts. The theorem is all-parameter subject to stated hypotheses, independent finite 1-skeleton tests supplement only.
residual_risks: Published cover theorem supplies the point-or-circle classification; this is not reproved here.
No independent full replay of all 50 finite cycle cases; published proof itself supplies universal reasoning.
